content.short: JEB Decompiler is a decompiler for EVM code.
content.description: The JEB Decompiler provides code analysis to determine contract methods without access to an ABI, allowing researchers to study contracts based on compiled bytecode alone. It is widely used by security auditors, vulnerability researchers, and reverse engineers who investigate opaque smart contracts on Ethereum. Its EVM code analyzer analyzes a contract's public and private methods, including implementations of public methods synthesized by compilers, helping researchers understand potential vulnerabilities without relying on an ABI.
